title: Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
abstract: arXiv:2609.05527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. translated_title: 超越“AI辅助人类”：智能体时代人机团队的决策导向评估设计
translated_abstract: 无论编码智能体在工程师监督下工作，还是临床模型辅助放射科医生，部署的核心问题都是：是保留人机协作流程，还是用纯人工或纯智能体方案来替代它。人机协作流程只有同时优于这两种替代方案时才值得保留。然而一旦部署，这两种替代方案的结果都无法被观测到：要获得其中一种结果，意味着需要在该替代方案下重放任务，而每次重放都要消耗专家时间或计算资源。在固定的重放预算下，设计问题因此变成：哪些任务应该更有可能获得纯人工重放，哪些任务应该获得纯智能体重放。现有方法并未直接针对这一决策：智能体基准测试不会选择测量哪个缺失的基线，基于方差的采样忽略了两个比较中哪一个更接近失败，而贝叶斯信息方法则专注于学习模型参数而非做出部署决策。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种决策导向的评估设计方法，在固定重放预算下有针对性地分配纯人工或纯智能体基线重放，以判断人机协作流程是否真正优于两种单独基线，从而直接支持智能体时代人机团队的部署决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-targeted evaluation design that strategically allocates limited human-only and agent-only replays under a fixed budget to determine whether human-agent team workflows outperform both single baselines, directly supporting deployment decisions in the agentic era.
